sentences.text: Researchers identified six new genetic changes in the PRR12 gene among unrelated individuals with intellectual disability, a pattern that was statistically significant.
To investigate how this gene functions, the team utilized mice and human stem cells that were grown into brain-like tissue.
In these models, having only one working copy of the PRR12 gene hindered the development of brain cells and the growth of their connections, which is linked to cognitive problems.
The PRR12 protein was shown to be present at the control regions of important genes that manage brain cell growth and communication, such as SNCG.
Reducing the activity of the SNCG gene fixed the structural problems in the brain cells, which points to a possible treatment for children with this condition.
